title: New error code for invalid terms of service acceptance in Accounts API
summary: Adds invalid_tos_acceptance as a new error code in the requirements.errors array in the Accounts API. To learn more, see Account requirements errors.
migrationNotes: The Accounts API now includes invalid_tos_acceptance as a new error code in the requirements.errors array, providing more specific error reporting for terms of service acceptance issues.

Adds `invalid_tos_acceptance` as a new error code in the `requirements.errors` array in the Accounts API. To learn more, see [Account requirements errors](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20#account_object-requirements-errors).
